  • Method Details

    • start

      @Internal public void start()
      Start the subscription to channels. This method will subscribe to all channels that are currently subscribed in the broker, so it will receive messages from those channels.

    • close

      @Internal public void close()
      Close the subscription to channels. This method will unsubscribe from all channels that are currently subscribed in the broker, so it will stop receiving messages from those channels.

    • subscribe

      @Internal @Blocking public void subscribe()
      Subscribe to channels and lock the thread until an error occurs or the subscription is closed. This method will subscribe to all channels that are currently subscribed.

    • unsubscribe0

      @Internal public void unsubscribe0()
      Unsubscribe from channels and unlock the thread. This method will unsubscribe from all channels that are currently subscribed.
